summary: Enhance your skills with our Financial Sector Monitoring and Surveillance Training Course. Learn essential techniques to ensure compliance and mitigate risks.
lede: Financial monitoring and surveillance uses data analysis to track activity, identify anomalies and report findings. For financial-sector professionals responsible for oversight, this training supports measuring surveillance performance, detecting anomalies with analytics and AI, and communicating findings through clear reports. It also addresses setting targets and adapting monitoring plans to emerging threats.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals across the financial sector responsible for monitoring and surveillance.
modules: Metrics and KPIs in Financial Surveillance
Integration of Upstream and Downstream Data Flows
Building a Future-Ready Financial Monitoring Strategy
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of financial systems and prior experience in compliance or risk management roles.
